name: Peanut Butter Banana Roll-Up with Strawberries
instructions: Lay tortillas on a flat surface. Using a spatula, spread peanut butter evenly over one side of each tortilla.
Peel bananas and place one on the side of each tortilla. Roll the tortilla up around the banana and slice into pieces.
Divide rolls and strawberries onto plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
